sources: https://www.nps.gov/blri/planyourvisit/roadclosures.htm (read in a browser; last updated October 21, 2026)

status.source: https://www.nps.gov/blri/planyourvisit/mt-pisgah-cg.htm ('Mount Pisgah Campground OPEN') + https://www.nps.gov/blri/planyourvisit/roadclosures.htm (MP 405.5-408.8 'Elk Pasture Gap to Pisgah Store' Open, MP 408.8-411.9 'Pisgah Store (Pisgah Campground and Inn) to US Route 276' Open; no Pisgah facility closure listed) + recreation.gov availability (sites Reserved/Available through 2026-10-25), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 2026 season Friday May 22 - Sunday October 25; 'Closed for Winter October 26-May 21'. The Parkway's campgrounds open May through late October, weather permitting; exact dates shift each year.

season.source: https://www.nps.gov/blri/planyourvisit/mt-pisgah-cg.htm (Operating Hours & Seasons: 'Friday, May 22, 2026 - Sunday, October 25, 2026. Campground kiosk open 9:30 AM- 6:00 PM when the campground is open.' 'Closed for Winter October 26-May 21') + https://www.nps.gov/blri/planyourvisit/camping.htm ('open from May through late October, weather permitting. They are closed in winter'), read 2026-10-22

hookups.source: https://www.nps.gov/blri/planyourvisit/mt-pisgah-cg.htm ('Electric Hookups: 0', 'The campground has a dump station and potable water, but NO water or electric hookups') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234182 (notice: 'Electric, water, or sewer hook-ups are not available per site.'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 125 sites: 50 RV-only, 64 tent-only, 11 other. RIDB gives most RV sites 20-35 ft; a handful take 50-80 ft. 12 pull-throughs. At most two vehicles per site and most sites take one.

sites.source: https://www.nps.gov/blri/planyourvisit/mt-pisgah-cg.htm ('TOTAL SITES: 125', 'RV Only: 50', 'Tent Only: 64', 'Other: 11') + RIDB catalog for 234182 (Max Vehicle Length 20-80 on the 61 RV-equipment sites, 12 pull-through) + recreation.gov notice ('A maximum of two vehicles may be parked in each site ... Most sites are limited to one vehicle'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Hot showers (Loops B and C), flush toilets, dump station, drinking water and the camp store are all seasonal; the Pisgah Inn's restaurant and country store are next door. No cell reception or internet. Food storage lockers; amphitheater. Non-campers pay $6 for showers or the dump station.

facilities.source: https://www.nps.gov/blri/planyourvisit/mt-pisgah-cg.htm (Amenities: 'Camp Store Yes, Seasonal', 'Laundry No', 'Dump Station Yes, Seasonal', 'Potable Water - Seasonal', 'Internet Connectivity No', 'Cell Phone Reception No'; 'Flush Toilets - seasonal'; 'Hot - Seasonal') + recreation.gov ('There are showers in Loop B and Loop C') + https://www.nps.gov/blri/planyourvisit/camping.htm ('There is a $6.00 fee for non-campers to use showers or dump stations'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Run by the NPS (recreation.gov: not commercially managed). Some sites reservable up to six months ahead on recreation.gov or (877) 444-6777; the first-come sites 'must be booked in person at the campground kiosk' and are not tracked online. 'Oftentimes full each weekend and holidays.' recreation.gov caps a stay at 30 nights (30 a year).

booking.source: https://www.nps.gov/blri/planyourvisit/mt-pisgah-cg.htm ('Campsites are available on a first-come, first-served basis. In addition, advance reservations can be made for some campsites up to six months in advance by visiting www.recreation.gov or by calling (877) 444-6777') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234182 (description; is_commercially_managed false; rules maxConsecutiveStay 30, maxStay 30 days each year, minWeekendStay 0), read 2026-10-22

values.note: $30 a night for every site type (RV, standard and tent), 2026 season.

fees.source: https://www.nps.gov/blri/planyourvisit/mt-pisgah-cg.htm (Fees: 'Mount Pisgah Campground Fee $30.00') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234182/rates (Peak Season 2026-05-22 to 2026-10-25: RV NONELECTRIC 30, STANDARD NONELECTRIC 30, TENT ONLY NONELECTRIC 30), read 2026-10-22

discounts.source: https://www.nps.gov/blri/planyourvisit/mt-pisgah-cg.htm (Fees: 'Holders of the Interagency Senior, Access, Golden Age, or Golden Access passes are entitled to a 50% discount on the base fee of the site physically occupied by the pass holder'), read 2026-10-22

summary: NPS page and recreation.gov: open (no Helene closure; Parkway open MP 405.5-411.9), 2026 season May 22 - Oct 25. Confirmed $30 and no electric; added no water/sewer hookups, 125 sites (50 RV-only) to 80 ft with pull-throughs, seasonal showers/flush toilets/dump/water/camp store, no laundry/internet, rec.gov 6-month window, some FCFS, 30-night max, senior pass 50%. AWH note kept unchanged.
